statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
The patient has known atherosclerotic heart disease (I25.10)
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0)
The claim was denied with reason code CO-197
The denial reason is that required precertification or authorization was not obtained prior to the service date
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to correlate intermittent symptoms with potential arrhythmias
Mobile cardiac telemetry is medically necessary to assess the efficacy of current rate-control management
